race.comment: ROSELYN'S STAR (2) classy sprinter who saves his best for this track and trip. Thrown in the deep end with a respectable fifth to Tempted over 1000m at Randwick in the G2 Concorde. Resumes with the two sharp trials and can put these away from the good draw. POLYGLOT (7) distance specialist who was a month between runs when he defeated a handy field over this journey at Randwick. Tougher test now but looks well placed with the 53.5kg. ACCREDITED (3) savaged the line first up with the 60.5kg when third over 1100m at Randwick. Given the gun run from the low gate and presented at the right time before tiring to run eleventh in the LR The Hunter at Newcastle over 1300m. Blinkers first time and the booking of J Mac can see a sharp rebound. DISNECK (4) is going better than form suggests and the slight niggle is the drop in trip after running fifth in the LR The Hunter. Goes well here and stays in the mix. OUI OUI OUI (10) poor record at this track and is new to this trip. Minor claims.
